No suspicious network operations, obfuscated code, or unauthorized system modifications are present. All dependencies are legitimate Python packages required for functionality.

The package adheres to typical AUR packaging guidelines, with no signs of supply chain tampering or malicious behavior. While the skipped checksum reduces verifiability, it does not by itself indicate malice, especially in the context of a git source. The overall structure and commands used are consistent with benign, well-maintained AUR packages.
